title: File:Glossitis in Iron-deficiency Anaemia, a Thai female patient (2025).jpg
author: Chainwit.
description: This case of a Thai female adult was presented to a public hospital in northern Thailand with complaints of tongue enlargement. The diagnosis of glossitis was made. Further investigation revealed anaemia where iron-deficiency anaemia was later confirmed, with suspicion of hypermenorrhoea as the cause.
